items.question: What claim about the fate of beings requires that torment occurs within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams form a fixed set of locations.
Beings are situated within those womb-diagrams at the relevant time.
Such placement entails a condition of torment for those beings.
items.inference: Beings are tormented by virtue of their presence in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The precise mode of torment is not specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
